searchKeyword.title: Search Keyword
searchKeyword.description: Keyword to search for products in Rakuten Ichiba.

ranking.title: Get Ranking
ranking.description: Set true to fetch the Rakuten Ichiba ranking (IchibaRanking API) instead of a keyword search.

genreId.title: Genre ID (for ranking)
genreId.description: Restrict ranking to a genre (e.g. 101269=本・雑誌, 101347=おもちゃ, 101031=ゲーム, 100371=家電). Only used when ranking=true.

rankingType.title: Ranking Type
rankingType.description: Ranking type when ranking=true: item (default), male, or female.

era.title: Era (past ranking)
era.description: Past-ranking era as YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20190601). Only used when ranking=true. Leave empty for current ranking.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (max 100).
